name: pi-tree
description: AI that reads with you — tree-structured conversations for books, papers, news, and more

scripts.build: npm run build -w @pi-tree/shared && npm run build -w @pi-tree/core && npm run build -w @pi-tree/plugin-sdk && npm run build -w @pi-tree/server && npm run build -w @pi-tree/mcp && npm run build -w @pi-tree/client && npm run build -w @pi-tree/electron
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build -w @pi-tree/electron && npm run dev -w @pi-tree/electron
scripts.electron:dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w @pi-tree/electron
scripts.electron:dist:linux: npm run build && npm run dist:linux -w @pi-tree/electron
scripts.electron:dist:mac: npm run build && npm run dist:mac -w @pi-tree/electron
scripts.electron:dist:win: npm run build && npm run dist:win -w @pi-tree/electron
